digest.component_or_area: plan review gate calibration and measurement
propositions: Deterministic replay infrastructure (stratified sample, frozen baseline, metrics library, driver seams) was designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e3 but intentionally not landed on main.

The expensive ~450-run live gate replay batch was permanently rejected on cost grounds and superseded by the standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder in change #798 which accumulates verdict-perturbation signal from production reviews at zero marginal LLM cost.
The design removes recall contamination via a recall-stripped clone (delete REVIEW_RESULT.json files) and guards against baseline drift using material-fingerprint verification.
History-based baseline mining is infeasible; only ~4 plan-v3 sidecar baselines exist versus ~200 needed after the impact_model_version bump stranded the historical data.
